//: Two ways to use this. (1) Replace Dependabot: move it to the repository root and delete .github/dependabot.yml; running both on the same ecosystem produces duplicate pull requests. (2) Complement Dependabot: move it to the root, keep dependabot.yml, and set "enabledManagers": ["custom.regex"] so Renovate touches only versions.env, which Dependabot cannot read. Renovate needs its GitHub App installed. Either way, a bump of a checksum-pinned tool (TASK, TYPOS, ACTIONLINT) fails hygiene until the *_SHA256_* lines are updated in the Renovate pull request; that failure is the reminder.

customManagers.description: Tool pins in versions.env, annotated with a renovate comment. extractVersion= handles tags that carry more than the version, such as helm-v1.2.3
